name: Nhắc khoản nợ cũ
prompt: Create ONE production-quality Vietnamese transactional email visual, not a website. 1024x1024 square compact email; entire email visible, white outer margin, natural centered 600px layout, no browser chrome. Preserve its real white logo plaque with navy/green AK + AN KHANG HOME wordmark, emerald illustrated apartment-building banner, large white headline at left, illustration at right, curved pale mint lower edge, left-aligned body, thin fact dividers, signature. Match the reference closely; do not invent a different brand. EXACT TEMPLATE: Nhắc khoản nợ cũ; audience Tài khoản hệ thống; banner headline exactly 'NHẮC KHOẢN NỢ CŨ'. Semantic palette: amber; original logo colors remain navy/green. Banner illustration: compact cream apartment building, one old invoice sheet and calendar bookmark. No button and no external link; the message must be complete in the email. Close with 'Trân trọng,' and 'Đội ngũ An Khang Home'. Add tiny footer 'Dữ liệu minh họa · 09/10/2026'. This is a compact overdue reminder with short body, only two fact rows, one balance and minimal banner detail. AVOID: Gmail/browser UI, tabs, device frame, other brands, SPX, QR, passwords, fake phone/contact details, clutter, cards inside cards, multiple CTAs, repeated headings, tiny unreadable text, clipped footer, misspelled Vietnamese, unsupported success stamp, invented amounts, people, photorealistic luxury real estate, code or HTML annotations. CRITICAL PALETTE OVERRIDE: preserve the reference layout and illustration style, but RECOLOR THE ENTIRE LARGE BANNER BACKGROUND to amber. The semantic color must dominate the banner, not merely appear in a tiny icon. Only the original AK logo retains navy/green. Do not keep the emerald banner for this template. CRITICAL COMPACT OVERRIDE: fit entire email in 1024x1024. Reduce the illustrated banner to roughly 240px high; use a modest 32px headline, smaller logo, simple building/document vignette at right.
